Title: Health monitoring and alerts for Azure AD DS

Body.Content:
Azure Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) now includes a health page, where you can view active alerts that affect your managed domain.

 

Alerts for invalid customer configuration can be remediated in a self-service manner through alert-specific documentation. This provides a good starting point for customers to resolve known issues that affect their managed domains.

 

For more information, see the documentation about checking the health of a managed domain and troubleshooting alerts.
